description: An unknown object with a dynamic attribute and no common type converts to an unknown map of any
notes: The spec makes this conversion an error: the dynamic pseudo-type unifies with any other type by selecting it, and is the result only if all the types are dynamic, so the bool and the tuple still need a common type, which they don't have (spec.md#type-unification), and an operation on unknown values is an error when their types already rule it out (spec.md#unknown-values-and-the-dynamic-pseudo-type). go-cty's unify (cty/convert/unify.go) gives the dynamic pseudo-type for these attribute types, because neither the bool nor the tuple converts to the other while every type converts to the dynamic pseudo-type, and conversionObjectToMap (cty/convert/conversion_collection.go), unlike conversionTupleToList and conversionTupleToSet, doesn't then check that every attribute type is dynamic, so the unknown object converts to an unknown map of the dynamic pseudo-type. native/types/convert-unknown-tuple-to-list-of-any-with-dynamic-element-fails is the same conversion for a tuple and a list.
